name: watchvideo
description: Local video analyzer for Claude Code with three modes: hook (first 20 seconds only, one contact sheet per video, built for studying a whole competitor roster), condensed, and forensic (1 frame per second). Downloads with yt-dlp, tiles frames with ffmpeg, transcribes locally with Whisper, reads the sheets with Claude vision, researches the topic, and writes a dated run folder with the transcript and the hook/format/topic breakdown.
author: Charles J Dove
